title: FIPS 140-3 Phase 1 Crypto Inventory Input for SBOM Annotation (WO-032)
description: Schema for the flattened, package-level cryptographic inventory artifact consumed by `pipeline sbom annotate` (tools/pipeline/internal/cmd/annotate_sbom.go). This is intentionally a much narrower shape than fips/schemas/consolidated_inventory.json (the WO-019 capstone artifact) -- it is derived FROM that artifact and from fips/inventory/crypto_dependencies.yaml (WO-009), collapsing per-call-site and per-module records down to one entry per crypto-relevant package/module so the SBOM annotator can do a simple package-name lookup against the base SBOM's components.

schema_version.description: Schema version of this inventory-input document, independent of consolidated_inventory.json's own inventory_schema_version.

generated_from.description: Phase 1 source artifacts this file was derived from, for traceability back to WO-009/WO-019.

entries.description: One entry per crypto-relevant Go package or module.

package_name.description: Go standard library import path (e.g. crypto/aes) or module/sub-package path (e.g. golang.org/x/crypto/chacha20poly1305).

package_version.description: Resolved module version (from go.mod), or the Go toolchain version string for standard-library packages.

algorithms.description: Cryptographic algorithm(s) implemented or exposed by this package, as identified in the Phase 1 call-site inventory.

fips_approved.description: Whether the algorithm(s) are on the FIPS 140-3 Approved Algorithms list, per the classification rule set documented in fips/inventory/crypto_dependencies.yaml.

security_relevant.description: Whether this package performs a security-relevant cryptographic operation (vs. e.g. ASN.1/byte-string parsing helpers).

source_work_order.description: The Forge work order that originally classified this package (e.g. WO-005, WO-009).
